blocks.text: Ms. Rivera reached into a small box. “There’s one more thing we give people when they join a project.” She held up a small round sticker. It showed the future fire station. Across the bottom it read: STATION NO. 2. Beneath it were the words BUILDING BRIGHTER TOMORROWS. Leo’s eyes widened. “For our hard hats?” “For your hard hats,” Ms. Rivera said. “This sticker represents the project you’re going to follow from the ground up.”

One by one, the kids and Mrs. Harper placed their stickers in their own spots. Ben carefully lined his up. Maya checked hers twice before pressing it down. Steph picked the spot that looked best. Leo stuck his on quickly and grinned. Vinny made sure his did not cover anything important. Mr. Brooks nodded. “Now remember where you put them. Project stickers stay with you.” The kids looked at one another’s hard hats. Their first project had officially begun.
